scope: Fortran/C bindings linked to pinned Debian Tcl/Tk 8.6 development libraries. A checksum-guarded include edit selects Debian's tcl8.6/tcl.h path for the C macro wrappers; interfaces and calculation code are unchanged. Adapted from the upstream evaluation example, the consumer creates a Tcl interpreter, evaluates an in-memory sum-of-squares script, checks evaluation status and the integer result against Fortran, then destroys the interpreter. Tk graphical windows, extension modules, Tcl stubs and all bindings are not validated; the browser example requires no graphical display or network.
